Welcome to the Electrician's ULTIMATE Toolbag Tour for the Electrical Foreman (2024)! In this video we'll take you through the essential tools every electrical foreman should have in their toolbag.

Join us as we explore the must-have tools for 2024, including cutting-edge technology and classic favorites that every electrician relies on. From voltage testers to wire strippers. 

Whether you’re a seasoned foreman or just starting your career in the electrical field, this toolbag tour is designed to equip you with the knowledge to make informed decisions about your toolkit.

Don’t forget to subscribe to our channel for more expert tips, tool reviews, and insights into the world of electrical work. Hit the notification bell so you never miss an update!

In 2023, Zen Stewart decided to pivot from white‑collar work to becoming an electrician. She’s now a member of the electricians union, earning $21 an hour as an entry-level employee. She’s working to be accepted into the union’s apprenticeship program as she moves toward becoming a fully licensed electrician — a role that can pay nearly $100 an hour in some parts of the U.S.
